column1: # Words ending in a silent ه (خانه, not گره).
# silent: spellings like خانه‌ای، خانهٔ، خانه‌ی. voiced: spellings like گرهی.
# bare: the word with nothing attached. Counted over a 2026 corpus sample; a word
# is in with at least 20 silent-or-voiced spellings and silent ahead 10 to 1.
# A word not listed is unknown, not voiced. Left out: words in اه (voiced by
# rule), two-letter words, verse contractions (گه، ره) and imperatives (بده).
